status: ILLUSTRATIVE. Written for this prototype from public sources and common first-aid practice. Not an approved ERC SOP: a veterinarian must review every card, level and line before real use.

E.label: Emergency
E.response: Dispatch now. Bring the ERC vet onto the call.

D.label: Urgent
D.response: Vet calls back within 30 minutes; dispatch today.

C.label: Same day
C.response: Vet calls back today; visit if the vet decides.

A.label: Advice
A.response: Vet tele-advice; visit only if it gets worse.

closing.text: If it gets worse, or another animal falls sick, call again.

cards.title: Sudden death

fields.label: How many died
fields.ask: How many have died?

fields.label: Sick before dying
fields.ask: Was it sick before, or found dead?

fields.label: Blood from nose/mouth/anus
fields.ask: Any blood from the nose, mouth or back passage?

say.text: Please do not cut open or skin the dead animal. Keep it covered, away from dogs and the other animals, until the vet sees it.
Keep the other animals away from the place where it died.

cards.for_vet: Sudden death: carcass precautions before opening (anthrax, HS). DAHD Standard Veterinary Treatment Guidelines (2024).

cards.title: Possible poisoning

fields.label: Ate what, where
fields.ask: What did they eat, and where?

fields.label: How long ago
fields.ask: How long ago did they eat it?
fields.asked_if: how long ago|when did (they|it|she) eat|what time

say.text: Move all the animals away from that field or feed now.
Do not pour anything into their mouths.

cards.for_vet: Plant or chemical poisoning; young sorghum is the commonest cyanogenic source in India. DAHD Standard Veterinary Treatment Guidelines (2024), toxicology.

cards.title: Spreading disease

fields.label: New animals brought in
fields.ask: Did any new animals come in recently? From where, when?

fields.label: Others in the village
fields.ask: Are animals in other houses also sick?

fields.label: Sores in mouth or feet
fields.ask: Any sores in the mouth or on the feet?

fields.label: Vaccinated
fields.ask: Were they vaccinated? For what, when?

say.text: Keep the sick animals apart from the healthy ones, with separate water and feed.
Don't sell, buy or take animals to the santhe or common grazing until the vet sees them.

cards.for_vet: Contagious picture (PPR, FMD, HS, goat pox): consider sampling and reporting to the district. DAHD Standard Veterinary Treatment Guidelines (2024).

cards.title: Lumps on the skin

fields.label: Milk now vs before
fields.ask: How much milk now, and before?

fields.label: Others in the village
fields.ask: Are animals in other houses also sick?

fields.label: Vaccinated
fields.ask: Were they vaccinated? For what, when?

say.text: Keep her apart from the other cattle.
Keep flies and mosquitoes off with smoke or a net.

cards.for_vet: Skin nodules with fever and milk drop (lumpy skin disease): report; ring vaccination. DAHD Standard Veterinary Treatment Guidelines (2024).

cards.title: Belly pain or bloat

fields.label: Belly swollen
fields.ask: Is the belly swollen, on the left side?

fields.label: Ate what, where
fields.ask: What did they eat, and where?

say.text: Don't give any more feed until the vet advises.
If she can, keep her standing and walking slowly; don't let her lie flat on her side.

cards.for_vet: Colic/bloat; with a sudden death after a feed change, consider enterotoxaemia. DAHD Standard Veterinary Treatment Guidelines (2024).

cards.title: Difficult birth

fields.label: Straining for
fields.ask: How long has she been straining?

fields.label: What is showing
fields.ask: What can you see: head, legs, nothing?

fields.label: Anyone pulled
fields.ask: Has anyone tried pulling?

say.text: Please don't pull. Keep her in a clean, quiet place until the vet team comes.

cards.for_vet: Dystocia. DAHD Standard Veterinary Treatment Guidelines (2024), obstetrics.

cards.title: Cough or fast breathing

fields.label: Age
fields.ask: How old are they?

fields.label: Suckling or eating
fields.ask: Are they suckling or eating?

fields.label: Shed
fields.ask: Where do they sleep? Is the shed closed at night?

say.text: Keep them warm and out of the wind, and let them keep suckling.

cards.for_vet: Respiratory disease; in kids under 3 months in winter, a top cause of death. DAHD Standard Veterinary Treatment Guidelines (2024).

cards.title: Loose motions

fields.label: Blood in dung
fields.ask: Any blood in the dung?

fields.label: Drinking water
fields.ask: Are they drinking water?

say.text: Keep clean drinking water in front of them all the time.

cards.for_vet: Diarrhoea; check age, worms, coccidia, contagious causes. DAHD Standard Veterinary Treatment Guidelines (2024).

cards.title: Animal down
cards.triggers: \b(cannot stand|can.t stand|not (getting|able to get) up|fallen|fell down|lying (down|flat))\b

fields.label: Gave birth recently
fields.ask: Did she give birth recently? When?

say.text: Prop her up on her chest with sacks or straw; don't leave her flat on her side.
Do not pour water or medicine into her mouth.

cards.for_vet: Downer: milk fever if recently calved; check for poisoning and injury. DAHD Standard Veterinary Treatment Guidelines (2024).
